name: Fisher
what: Fishes an assigned ground and returns fish to the nearest cache; the economy. A fisher catches 3-6 fish a day by ground; dies to sharks if the ground is bloody.

name: Feeder
what: Carries fish from caches to nests and to birds on duty. Without feeders, every bird fetches its own and loses a third of its day.

name: Builder
what: Gathers twigs and shells; builds and repairs nests and caches. Three builders raise a nest in a game hour.
